repositories.localPathDescription: Enter the absolute path to a git repository containing worktrees.
repositories.validationNotGitRepo: This folder is not a git repository.

repositories.forkOptionHelp: Creates a fork in your GitHub account and clones that (origin = your fork, upstream = original). Requires an authenticated GitHub CLI (gh).
repositories.emptyDisabled: No repositories are excluded from scans.
repositories.disableConfirmBody:
"{name}" will no longer be scanned for worktrees.

Nothing is deleted: its {count} worktree(s) and their chat history, tasks and verification runs stay in the database, and any tmux session running under it keeps running.

Its worktrees also stay in the sidebar — use the Visibility toggle to hide them.

Its role defaults stay too, and apply again when it is scanned again.
repositories.duplicateScanRootWarning: Same git repository as an existing scan root: {paths}. Both will be scanned, and every worktree they share will be registered twice.
repositories.duplicateConfirmTitle: Register a second scan root for the same repository?
repositories.duplicateConfirmBody:
"{path}" is the same git repository as:
{paths}

Both roots list the same worktrees, so every sync registers each of them twice and their "repository path" flips between the roots run to run.

This is allowed — continue if you want to manage these worktrees as separate roots. Otherwise cancel, or use the Scan toggle on the Repositories list to exclude one of them later.
repositories.duplicateRowDetail: Same git repository as {paths}. Use the Scan toggle on one of these rows to exclude it from scans.
repositories.rolesKeptNote: An excluded repository keeps its role defaults, and uses them again when it is scanned again.

agentUpdates.restartWarning: These sessions keep the current version until they are restarted: {sessions}

settings.title: Settings
settings.pageDescription: Defaults for new branches, notifications, external apps, and more.

defaultSurfaceMode.title: Default output surface
defaultSurfaceMode.description: Which surface a session's output half opens in: the live terminal, or the conversation transcript. You can still switch either way from the session header.
defaultSurfaceMode.appliesToNew: Only affects surfaces you have not switched yet. A split or phone tab you already toggled keeps the mode you left it in.

hint.terminal: The agent's terminal, exactly as it is drawn in tmux.
hint.chat: The conversation transcript, as a message list.

defaultAgents.title: Default agents for new branches
defaultAgents.description: The agents a newly discovered branch opens with, in order. The first one is the primary — the tab that opens first and the default target for sends.
defaultAgents.appliesToNew: Existing branches are left alone. Their tabs stay exactly as they are.
defaultAgents.opencodeSharedData: OpenCode and OpenCode V2 are both installed. They share ~/.local/share/opencode, and V2 changes the database in ways OpenCode 1.x cannot read — if OpenCode fails to start, use OpenCode V2 only or give OpenCode 1.x its own data directory.

newTask.title: New task
newTask.loadError: Could not load the branch list.
newTask.noTargets: No branch has an agent to send to.
newTask.willStart: {agent} is not running. It will be started, then the request is sent.
newTask.startingNotice: {agent} is still starting. If the send is refused, wait a moment and send again.
newTask.modelHintSwitch: Switches the running session to this model.

modelUnavailable.unsupported: {agent} does not take a model on send.
modelUnavailable.running: {agent} is already running. A model can only be set when it starts — stop the session first to switch.

newTask.autoYesActive: On for this agent, {remaining} left. Left as it is.
newTask.autoYesUnknown: Could not confirm the Auto-Yes state; it may be on for this agent.
newTask.autoYesScope: Applies to this agent until it expires, not only to this request.
newTask.sentToast: Sent to {target}. Click to go back.

errors.auto_yes_failed: Auto-Yes could not be turned on, so nothing was sent.
errors.prompt_waiting: {agent} is waiting on a prompt, so nothing was sent. Answer it on the branch screen, then send again.
errors.starting: {agent} is still starting. Wait a moment and send again.
errors.model_rejected: The model was not accepted. Clear it or change it, then send again.
errors.failed: Sending failed. Check the connection and send again.

agentRoles.title: Roles
agentRoles.loadError: Could not read the role information.
agentRoles.description: A role is the instructions given to a session when it starts. Write a body per role, then use it as a per-tool default or on one session. It resolves session → repository → system. Changing a setting does not reach a running session until its next start.
agentRoles.personaNote: OpenCode's persona (build, plan, …) is not a role. A persona is the agent you switch inside OpenCode; a role is instructions CommandMate gives at startup.
agentRoles.replacesDefaultNote: On OpenCode V2 a role replaces the agent's default instructions rather than adding to them.
agentRoles.resumedAcrossRoleNote: This start continued an earlier conversation, so replies from another role are still in its history. A new conversation can be started at the next start.
agentRoles.adapterDisabledNote: Applying a role to this tool is not enabled yet. A start that resolves to a role is refused.
agentRoles.unsupportedNote: Roles do not apply to this tool.

ambiguous.rootSettingsDiffer: Cannot tell: the repositories this branch belongs to hold different settings ({roots}). Starts are refused until the repositories agree or the session names a role.
ambiguous.membershipUndetermined: Cannot tell: git could not confirm which repository this belongs to ({roots}). Starts are refused until that is resolved or the session names a role.

agentRoles.savedStale: The latest state could not be read back after a change, so this may be out of date. Reload the page.
agentRoles.saveUnknown: Whether this was saved could not be confirmed. Check the current setting.

application.restartHint: Ends the session. The next message starts a new one with the current settings.

instances.title: Session roles
instances.description: Choose a role per session. A change is used from the next start.
instances.restartConfirm: End the session of {alias}? The next message starts a new one with the current settings.
instances.restartUnknown: Whether the session ended could not be confirmed. Check whether it is still running.
instances.restartInProgress: The session is still running. Ending it may still be in progress. Wait a moment, then check whether it is still running.
instances.runningUnknown: Could not read which sessions are running, so the status below does not say whether they are.

repository.description: The default per tool for this repository's branches.

system.title: System defaults
system.description: Used when neither the repository nor the session says otherwise.

manage.name: Name
manage.bodyPlaceholder: e.g. You are the code reviewer.
manage.nameConflict: A role with this name already exists.
manage.versionConflict: This role was edited elsewhere. Close this and open it again.
manage.edited: Saved. {count} setting(s) that name this role use the new body from their next start.
manage.inUse: This role is used in these places. Deleting it removes these settings too. Launch records and generated files stay.

mem.loadError: Could not read the mem settings.
mem.description: Decide per branch whether mem is used: the branch override, then the rules (the first that matches from the top), then off. Off by default.
mem.limits: Only this screen changes the mode. A process with the same OS rights (agents included) can still write the database or the API directly; that is not prevented.

status.conflict: Changed elsewhere. The latest settings are shown; save again.
status.invalid: Some values cannot be stored (check the patterns and branch names).

decisions.open: Record decisions in their canonical place
decisions.title: Recording decisions ({branch})
decisions.description: A person checks the diff and records a decision left in mem as an Issue comment or in a document of a worktree. Nothing is written until you press "Approve and write". CommandMate never commits or pushes.
decisions.limits: What this cannot stop: a process running with the same OS rights can fake the screen's mark and write the database directly. Agents do not approve because the CLI has no way to and the skills say so, not because it is guaranteed.
decisions.noWorktree: No worktree is on this branch
decisions.none: No decision is waiting to be recorded
decisions.ambiguous: The roots disagree on mem's setting for this branch ({roots}). Decisions cannot be listed, approved or moved; only an outcome written outside can be reconciled.
decisions.modeNotOn: mem is not on for this branch ({mode}). Approving and recording need on.
decisions.unreflected: Not reflected: recorded as a comment only, not yet reflected in the canonical place (such as the Issue body)

effect.label: Effect
effect.spec: Changes the specification (recorded, waiting for reflection, once written)
effect.record_only: Record only (the specification does not change)

decisions.quoteConfirmed: I checked the quote against the original
decisions.invisible: Invisible characters were replaced with [U+XXXX] (also in the branch or the author; a branch is written in its omitted form)
decisions.confirmReflected: I checked it is reflected in the canonical place
decisions.abandon: I checked it is not there
decisions.markFound: The reconcile found this operation's mark, but not what was meant to be written ({reason}). Reconcile to see both side by side, and judge from both. "I checked it is not there" lets the next approval write the same decision again
decisions.found: What was found (as it is now)
decisions.intended: What was meant to be written (the approved body)
decisions.acknowledgeItemClosed: Treat as recorded (the outcome only; the closed item does not move)
decisions.acknowledgeDiff: I checked the item changed after it was written

operation.unknown: Outcome unknown: never sent again by itself. Reconcile it
operation.abandoned: Checked as not there (treated as not sent)

decisions.unresolved: Operations still unsettled after their item was closed or deleted
decisions.unresolvedAmbiguous: Operations still unsettled (their item does not move until the roots agree)
decisions.pending: Written, but the item did not move ({reason})
decisions.concurrent: Something else changed the document while writing. Check the document
decisions.reapproval: Changed since the approval ({reason}). Make the diff again

modeHelp.off: Nothing is evaluated, written or inserted. The items are kept.
modeHelp.derived: Only derived state (waits, relays) goes into the brief. Agent writes and condition checks stop; the items are shown frozen.
modeHelp.on: Items are added, edited, checked against their conditions and inserted.

featureHelp.injectOnStart: Attach a short summary (brief) to the first send after a session boundary (start, reset, resume).
featureHelp.promptOnEvents: After an action (a PR, a merge), prompt the agent to update mem.
featureHelp.popup: Attended: on a branch with mode on, "end" shows the hand-off (approve the agent's proposals, then a person presses stop). The screen that asks when a session opens does not appear yet. Off (the default) is unattended. Separate from auto-yes.

items.title: mem items ({branch})
items.description: View this branch's mem items; a person adds, edits and closes them. Items a person writes are created and updated by human.
items.limits: What this cannot prevent: a process with the same OS rights can forge the screen's mark and write the DB directly. An item a person wrote cannot be changed or closed by an agent through the CLI (a close by its condition still applies). An agent writing its own item through the CLI at the same time is not stopped (the version check shows it as a conflict).
items.derived: Frozen: agent writes and condition checks are stopped. This screen cannot write either.
items.off: off: the items are kept but not shown.
items.readOnly: To write, choose a worktree of this branch and an instance of its roster (an item is owned by an instance).
items.otherBranch: The chosen worktree is not on this branch now. Read only.
items.evidence: Evidence paths (comma separated, relative to the repository)
items.withheld: The text is not shown ({field} matched rule {rule})
items.nowNote: A now slot is edited from the session note (the worktree screen).

conflict.title: It was changed elsewhere. Compare your draft, the value you read and the current value.
conflict.rebase: Save my draft on top of the current value
conflict.sends: Fields saving on top sends (only the ones you changed): {fields}

recordedClose.first: This decision is recorded but not reflected in the canonical place (such as the Issue body).
recordedClose.second: This decision is recorded; it will be closed without being reflected in the canonical place (such as the Issue body). Comments and other records stay.

refusal.disabled: mem is not on for this branch. Nothing can be written.
refusal.version_conflict: It was changed elsewhere (the version differs).
refusal.state_forbids: This cannot be done in the item's current state (closed, or recorded).
refusal.not_owner: This item cannot be changed (an agent's item: its author's instance or a person; a person's item: a person only).
refusal.incarnation_changed: The worktree or the instance was replaced since it was read. Read again.
refusal.membership_changed: The worktree is on another branch than this screen's. Nothing was written.
refusal.confirmation_required: Closing a recorded decision needs the confirmation that it is not reflected.
refusal.screen_only: This change is made from the screen only.
refusal.duplicate_key: The same request was sent with other content.
refusal.limit_exceeded: Too many open items of this kind.
refusal.secret_like: A field looks like it contains a secret.
refusal.invalid_close_when: The close condition is not valid. E.g. issue:#123, pr:#45, manual
refusal.invalid_close_when_required: This kind (waiting, next, external) needs a close condition. Write one such as issue:#123 or pr:#45.
refusal.invalid_close_when_kind: This kind does not take that close condition.
refusal.invalid_close_when_reason: The close condition is not written correctly ({reason}). E.g. issue:#123, pr:#45, manual

notices.title: Undelivered notices
notices.none: No notice is waiting to be taken.
notices.uncertain: An earlier delivery could not be confirmed

items.unknown: The result is unknown (timed out or the connection was lost). It may or may not have been written; pressing again sends the same content with the same key (if it was written, no second item is made and the same item comes back).
items.addPending: The result of the last add is unknown. The input is held until it is sent again (the same content and key, so no second item).
items.unknownVersioned: The result is unknown (timed out or the connection was lost). Pressing again sends the same content with the same version. If the first send was written, or someone else changed the item, it comes back as a version conflict with the comparison (the screen does not guess that it was saved).
items.pendingElsewhere: There is an {op} whose result is unknown (to {worktree} · {instance}). It cannot be sent again with the current selection. Go back to that destination, or do not send it again.
items.pendingDiscard: Do not send again (check the list for whether it was written)
items.lockedSending: Sending. Until the answer comes back, no other write (add, edit, close) can be made and the fields sent cannot be changed.
items.lockedUnknown: A request's result is unknown. Until you send it again or choose "Do not send again", no other write (add, edit, close, save on top, close again) can be made and that request's fields cannot be changed (so nothing is written twice or mixed up). Reading again and changing the worktree or instance still work.
items.lockedElsewhere: Another screen (the hand-off before ending) has an item write being sent or with an unknown result. Until it settles nothing can be written here (reading again and changing the selection still work).
items.closeWhenKeep: Close condition (empty keeps the current {type}; writing one replaces it)
items.closeWhenRequiredHelp: {kind} needs a close condition (required for waiting, next and external; e.g. issue:#123, pr:#45, branch:feature/x?merged=develop).

closeConflict.title: It was changed elsewhere before closing. Compare what you read with the current value and choose again whether to close it.
closeConflict.again: Close it again, having seen the current value

handoff.title: Hand-off before ending ({label})
handoff.sessionUnknown: No conversation is recorded for this session, so no hand-off request can be made. You can still stop it (no hand-off is recorded).
handoff.sessionChanged: The session was replaced after the request. Stopping acts on the current session (no hand-off is recorded).
handoff.unknown: The result of the confirmation is not known. Send the same again or drop it. Until then no other item can be written.
handoff.someNotApplied: Some proposals were not confirmed (conflict or failure). See the list.
handoff.sendFailed: The request could not be sent. Send it again, stop without proposals, or don't end.
handoff.agentTimeout: The agent has not said it is done in time. Wait (+5 min), go on with what came, stop without proposals, or don't end.
handoff.direct: Updates made without a proposal (read only; not rolled back)
handoff.notStopped: The stop could not be confirmed. Press Stop again.
handoff.lockedElsewhere: Another screen has an item write being sent or with an unknown result. Until it settles, approving, discarding and moving are not possible.
handoff.lockedSending: Sending the confirmation. Until it answers, no other item can be written.
handoff.lockedUnknown: A confirmation's result is not known. Until it is resent or dropped, no other item can be written.

state.reviewing: Look at the proposals and choose what to approve.
state.expired: The request expired, or the session was replaced.

outcome.confirmed: Ended with the updates before ending confirmed.
outcome.unconfirmed: The updates before ending could not be confirmed ({reason}). The next session is told so.

refusal.disabled: mem is not on for this branch.
refusal.session_changed: The session was replaced after the request.
refusal.request_closed: This request no longer takes this.
refusal.version_conflict: The request moved on since it was read. Look at it now and choose again.
refusal.proposal_changed: The proposal changed since it was shown.
refusal.state_forbids: Not possible in the current state.
refusal.extend_limit: It cannot be extended any more.
refusal.not_stopped: The stop could not be confirmed.
refusal.end_token_changed: This is not the stop that was declared.
refusal.already_recorded: How it ended is already recorded.
refusal.screen_only: This is done from the screen only.

handoff.closeWhileStopping: The stop is in progress. This cannot be closed (or the end cancelled) until it finishes.
handoff.closeWhileUnknown: A confirmation is being sent or its result is unknown. Send it again or drop it before closing.
handoff.closeWhileCancelling: The end is being cancelled. This cannot be closed, and no confirmation is sent, until it is answered.
handoff.pendingElsewhere: This confirmation is for worktree {worktree}. To send it again, open this on that worktree (here it can only be dropped).
handoff.foreign: This dialog is the hand-off before ending on worktree {worktree}. Nothing can be stopped or confirmed on this worktree; go back to that worktree to go on.
handoff.plainStopped: Stopped. Send the confirmation whose result is unknown again, or drop it, before closing.
